about_the_game:
Dig, build, and play in a physics-driven sandbox world where heavy machinery meets creativity.

Take control of powerful construction vehicles—from skid steers to excavators—and tear into fully deformable terrain. Every scoop of dirt is simulated, every load has weight, and every pile you make stays where you left it. Digger Sandbox is all about giving you the tools and letting you decide what to build, destroy, or experiment with.

🔑 Features

  • Fully Diggable Terrain – Shape the world with voxel-based digging, dumping, and sculpting.

  • Realistic Physics – Buckets fill with dirt, loads shift with momentum, and vehicles feel weighty.

  • Multiple Vehicles – Jump into skid steers, excavators, and more heavy machinery, each with unique controls.

  • Sandbox Freedom – No missions, no timers—just you, the dirt, and endless possibilities.

  • Multiplayer Support – Work together (or cause chaos) with friends online.

  • Persistent Worlds – Save your construction sites and return later to continue your projects.

🎮 Why Play?

Whether you want to build the ultimate construction site, dig giant holes just because you can, or test the limits of physics with friends, Digger Sandbox is your playground for heavy machinery mayhem.

Get in, start digging, and make a mess worth remembering.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 or AMD FX-8120
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 750 4GB, Radeon RX 460 4GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8600K or AMD Ryzen 5 2600X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1070 8 GB, Radeon RX 580 8GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: Dig, build, and experiment in a physics-driven sandbox where heavy machinery meets creativity. Operate real construction vehicles, sculpt terrain with simulated dirt blocks, and team up with friends in a persistent diggable world.
